Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ قَوِّنِيْ فِيْهِ عَلَى إِقَامَةِ أَمْرِكَ
Translation: O Allah, strengthen me in it to establish Your command
And let me taste in it the sweetness of Your remembrance
And grant me in it the ability to give thanks to You by Your generosity
And protect me in it with Your protection and Your cover
O Most Seeing of all those who see
